findings.name: Right pleural effusion
findings.note: A massive effusion filling almost the whole right pleural cavity.

findings.name: Right lung compressed by effusion
findings.note: All that is left aerated of the right lung, squashed up against the apex.

findings.name: Mediastinum shifted to the left
findings.note: Fluid under pressure pushes the heart and trachea away from the side it is on.

findings.name: Small bilateral pleural effusions
findings.note: Small effusions blunting both costophrenic angles, as in heart failure.

findings.name: Collapsed left lung (pneumothorax)
findings.note: Air in the pleural space has let the left lung fall away from the chest wall.

findings.name: Air in the left pleural space
findings.note: The pleural cavity the lung has retreated from - no lung markings out here.

findings.name: Consolidated right middle lobe
findings.note: The right middle lobe filled with inflammatory exudate instead of air.

findings.name: Enlarged heart
findings.note: The cardiac silhouette of a dilated heart, over half the width of the chest.

findings.name: Soft tissue of head and neck (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Soft tissue of trunk (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Soft tissue of right upper limb (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Soft tissue of left upper limb (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Soft tissue of right lower limb (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Soft tissue of left lower limb (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Left acetabular posterior column fragment
findings.note: A displaced fragment of the posterior column of the left acetabulum, part of a comminuted fracture.

findings.name: Left acetabular anterior column fragment
findings.note: A fragment of the anterior column of the left acetabulum, displaced from the socket rim.

findings.name: Left acetabular comminuted fragments
findings.note: Several small loose bone fragments in the left acetabulum, the comminution the source describes.

findings.name: Left acetabular fracture line
findings.note: The fracture line crossing the left acetabulum from the posterior column to the anterior column.

findings.name: Right renal calculus
findings.note: A small dense calculus in the lower, medial part of the right kidney; it is bright on non-contrast CT.

findings.name: Left renal calculus
findings.note: A small dense calculus in the left kidney, near the renal pelvis; it is bright on non-contrast CT.

findings.name: Left subdural haematoma (convexity)
findings.note: Acute blood lying as a crescent between the left cerebral convexity and the inner table of the skull, the thicker collection on this scan.

findings.name: Right subdural haematoma (convexity)
findings.note: A thinner crescent of acute blood between the right frontoparietal convexity and the skull, the second collection on this scan.

findings.name: Right proximal ureteric stone
findings.note: A calculus lodged in the right proximal ureter just below the renal pelvis, the obstructing stone described in the source.

findings.name: Saddle pulmonary embolus
findings.note: A saddle clot sits across the pulmonary arterial bifurcation and extends into both pulmonary arteries.

findings.name: Left lobar pulmonary embolus
findings.note: Clot extending from the bifurcation into the left pulmonary artery.

findings.name: Right lobar pulmonary embolus
findings.note: Clot extending from the bifurcation into the right pulmonary artery.

findings.name: T10 Chance fracture
findings.note: A horizontal (Chance) fracture runs through the T10 vertebral body and posterior elements after a seatbelt injury in a motor vehicle collision.

findings.name: T9 vertebral body fracture
findings.note: An associated fracture through the T9 vertebral body from the same seatbelt injury.

findings.name: Aortic dissection flap
findings.note: The intimal flap splitting the descending thoracic aorta into a true and a false lumen, as in a Stanford type B dissection.

findings.name: Transverse myelitis central cord hyperintensity
findings.note: Increased central T2 signal in a segment of the cervical cord, the MRI sign of transverse myelitis (inflammation across the cord).

findings.name: Gallbladder stones
findings.note: Multiple gallstones in the gallbladder, seen as filling defects in the fluid-filled gallbladder on MRCP.

findings.name: Common bile duct stone
findings.note: A stone lodged in the common bile duct, causing a filling defect in the otherwise fluid-filled duct on MRCP.

findings.name: Dilated left ventricle
findings.note: The left ventricular cavity is enlarged and rounded, as in the left image. This shows chamber size only; contractility and ejection fraction are not reported.

findings.name: Left basal ganglia infarct
findings.note: Hyperacute left basal ganglia infarction: restricted diffusion, bright on DWI and low on ADC four hours after onset. Conventional T2 did not show it clearly.

findings.name: L4-L5 left paramedian disc herniation
findings.note: Posterior herniation of the L4–L5 disc, left paramedian, indenting the thecal sac and the emerging left L5 root sheath.

findings.name: Uterine fibroid (illustrative)
findings.note: Well-circumscribed uterine fibroid (leiomyoma) in the central pelvis, shown illustratively. The atlas has no uterus, so its position is approximate.

findings.name: Second uterine fibroid (illustrative)
findings.note: Second uterine fibroid in the central pelvis, shown illustratively next to the first.

findings.name: Right frontal cortical infarct
findings.note: Subacute cortical infarct of the right frontal lobe: restricted diffusion on DWI with gadolinium enhancement of the cortex on enhanced T1 from blood-brain-barrier disruption.

findings.name: Supraspinatus tendon tear
findings.note: Complete full-thickness tear of the supraspinatus tendon, about 2.4 cm wide, with the gap filled by fluid.

findings.name: Left basal ganglia infarct (mri_hyperacute_basal_ganglia_infarct_adc)
findings.note: Hyperacute infarction of the left basal ganglia: restricted diffusion with low ADC, bright on the paired DWI.

findings.name: Right medial thalamic FLAIR signal abnormality
findings.note: Hyperintense FLAIR signal in the right mesial dorsal thalamus, the abnormality described in Wernicke encephalopathy (oedema or gliosis; illustrative marker, not registered to this scan).

findings.name: Left medial thalamic FLAIR signal abnormality
findings.note: Hyperintense FLAIR signal in the left mesial dorsal thalamus, the abnormality described in Wernicke encephalopathy (oedema or gliosis; illustrative marker, not registered to this scan).

findings.name: Dilated oesophagus in achalasia
findings.note: The lower oesophageal sphincter fails to relax, so the oesophagus dilates above it and fills with retained barium and food.

findings.name: Killian-Jamieson diverticulum
findings.note: A small lateral outpouching of the cervical oesophagus just below the cricopharyngeus, retaining contrast on the barium swallow.

findings.name: Cerebral arterial aneurysm
findings.note: A rounded saccular outpouching of an intracranial artery on catheter angiography, with the sac filled by contrast.

findings.name: Left renal artery bead 1
findings.note: Fibromuscular dysplasia of the lower accessory left renal artery: one bead of the string-of-beads wall contour.

findings.name: Left renal artery bead 2
findings.note: Fibromuscular dysplasia of the lower accessory left renal artery: a second bead of the string-of-beads wall contour.

findings.name: Left renal artery bead 3
findings.note: Fibromuscular dysplasia of the lower accessory left renal artery: a third bead of the string-of-beads wall contour.

findings.name: Right renal artery distal aneurysm
findings.note: A small saccular aneurysm of the distal right renal artery, as described in the source image.

findings.name: Posterior tibial artery occlusion
findings.note: A clot fills the posterior tibial artery from its origin to the ankle, so it is not opacified on the angiogram.

findings.name: Collateral vessels around the occlusion
findings.note: Small collateral channels bridge from the posterior tibial artery to the fibular artery and carry blood around the occlusion.

findings.name: Proximal femoral occlusion
findings.note: A thrombus fills the upper femoral artery, so contrast does not pass beyond it.

findings.name: Distal popliteal occlusion
findings.note: A thrombus at the popliteal artery blocks flow to the leg below the knee.

findings.name: Left subcapital insufficiency fracture
findings.note: Focal tracer uptake at the left subcapital femoral neck, the insufficiency fracture the bone scan shows.

findings.name: Hodgkin paratracheal nodal mass
findings.note: FDG-avid enlarged mediastinal lymph node mass to the right of the trachea, typical of Hodgkin lymphoma. Shown as an illustrative mass; the 3D atlas is not registered to this scan.

findings.name: Left ICA complete occlusion
findings.note: Thrombus filling the left internal carotid artery, giving the complete occlusion described by the source; the clot is illustrative and is not seen directly on the B-mode image.

findings.name: Common carotid intimal flap (dissection)
findings.note: A thin intimal flap lies within the common carotid artery and separates two lumen channels. The source does not state the side or which channel is the true lumen; the left side is shown for illustration only.

findings.name: Left ICA near-occlusion plaque
findings.note: Atheromatous plaque narrowing the left internal carotid artery lumen to near occlusion, with only residual flow.

findings.name: Hydronephrosis (dilated renal pelvis)
findings.note: Obstructed urine backs up and dilates the renal pelvis and calyces, shown here as an anechoic collecting system on ultrasound.

findings.name: Gallstones (dependent, shadowing)
findings.note: Echogenic gallstones lying in the dependent part of the gallbladder, producing posterior acoustic shadowing.

findings.name: Biliary sludge (dependent layer)
findings.note: Mixed echoes of biliary sludge layering in the dependent gallbladder lumen beneath the stones.

findings.name: Impacted gallstone
findings.note: A stone of about 1.9 cm impacted at the gallbladder neck, the cause of the acoustic shadow behind it on ultrasound.

findings.name: Gallbladder wall thickening
findings.note: Thickened gallbladder wall (about 4 mm) from acute inflammation, as reported with the cholecystitis.

findings.name: Hashimoto thyroiditis enlarged right lobe
findings.note: Diffuse lymphocytic inflammation enlarges and darkens the right thyroid lobe on ultrasound; the lobe is hypoechoic and heterogeneous.

findings.name: Femoral vein thrombus
findings.note: Thrombus filling the femoral vein; the vein lacks colour flow on Doppler, while the femoral artery and deep femoral vein fill with colour.

findings.name: Abdominal aortic aneurysm
findings.note: Focal dilatation of the infrarenal-to-suprarenal abdominal aorta seen in transverse section; the image shows enlargement without a calibrated diameter.

findings.name: Baker's cyst fluid
findings.note: A fluid collection in the popliteal fossa between the semimembranosus tendon and the medial head of gastrocnemius, seen as an elongated anechoic cyst on longitudinal ultrasound.

findings.name: Dilated small bowel with air-fluid levels
findings.note: Distended small bowel loops hold fluid with gas above, giving horizontal air-fluid levels on the upright film. A single projection does not show the transition point.

findings.name: L3 compression fracture
findings.note: Anterior-superior wedge collapse of the L3 vertebral body with reduced height and depression of the upper endplate.

findings.name: Distal radius fracture
findings.note: Transverse fracture through the distal radial metaphysis with the distal fragment displaced dorsally (Colles pattern).

findings.name: Dorsally displaced radial fragment
findings.note: Distal radial fragment displaced dorsally at the Colles fracture site.

findings.name: Ulnar styloid fracture
findings.note: Fracture of the ulnar styloid process at the distal ulna, with a small separated tip fragment.

findings.name: Clavicular fracture
findings.note: Transverse fracture of the mid-shaft of the left clavicle with separated fragments.

findings.name: Calcaneal fracture line
findings.note: Fracture line through the body of the calcaneus, seen as a disrupted heel-bone contour on the lateral radiograph.

findings.name: Right renal calculus (xr_bilateral_renal_stones)
findings.note: Radiopaque renal calculus in the right kidney, visible on the frontal abdominal radiograph.

findings.name: Left renal calculus (xr_bilateral_renal_stones)
findings.note: Radiopaque renal calculus in the left kidney, visible on the frontal abdominal radiograph.

findings.name: Dilated upper lobe vessels
findings.note: Upper-lobe arteries and veins are equal to or wider than the lower-lobe ones: blood diverted to the upper zones as pulmonary venous pressure rises.
